_readme: A real save in the version 9 shape - the last one to record where the player stood in PIXELS - pinned so the v9->v10 step is tested against a FILE rather than a dictionary a test just built. The position is tile (5.5, 2.5) of a 16px map, which is a whole tile plus a half on both axes: a fixture standing on a tile corner would pass a step that rounded, and one on a whole tile would pass a step that floored. It carries a companion, a bag, a purse and worn gear because a step that dropped any of them while converting the position would otherwise still pass.
